name: ESOI inside other people's running code
vision_statement: The esoi package is a dependency of other people's production code, which declares its alternatives gracefully and selects the best implementation while it runs.
opportunities: The Python package can become a runtime dependency inside other people's production code, not only a tool run on a repository: selection at run time, graceful declarations of alternatives (decorators, for example) and embedding without forking. That is a creative space beyond selecting an implementation by a table in one repository.
solution_coherence: The package becomes a dependency of other people's running code through two solutions. Assemble by name (assemble-by-name) lets a program build its parts by the names of the solutions they serve, checking needs and failing at startup on a cycle or an unmet need, and Select an implementation while the program runs (runtime-selection) then chooses, call by call, which declared implementation serves, from the program's own configuration and the recorded results, so a better implementation is used without editing the program.
